snippet.title: NeverGiveUp NeverGiveIn
snippet.description: A message of hope to those who have faced circumstances of hardship and difficulty, whether brought on by oneself, others, or anything at all. The time for self-doubt is over. The time for what-ifs is over. The time to get up, get out, and do is here. Whatever your aspiration, you can make it happen. In 2006, I was convicted of two felonies and ended up doing time in prison. I was released to mandatory supervision in April 2013, then returned to prison in 2018. The very same date (April 19) that I was released from prison in 2013, is the date that I returned to prison in 2018. I was released to mandatory supervision again in November 2019. I just completed parole on March 18, 2020. This channel will be a blog about my experiences, my goals, and my thoughts on the things I strive to achieve. Through this channel, it is my hope that I can inspire someone else to go after a dream, to go after a desire, to believe in him/herself when he/she may have given up or thought of giving up.

snippet.title: Someday Travel
snippet.description:
Welcome to Someday Travel.
This channel was born from heartbreak, healing, and a search for meaning.

After losing my son in 2019, I found myself wandering—not aimlessly, but intentionally—through places I’d never been, inside and out. Grief changed everything. It pushed me toward solo travel, deep reflection, duck blinds at sunrise, unexpected friendships, and quiet conversations over whiskey. Through storytelling, writing, and raw experiences, I’ve discovered that the road can offer more than escape—it can offer connection, clarity, and sometimes, even peace.

Someday Travel is where I share that journey. It’s a mix of travel vlogs, bourbon reviews, reflections on life and loss, and the kind of stories you tell around a fire with good friends. It's about learning to live again, love again, and dream—always.

If you’ve ever felt the weight of grief or the pull of the open road, you’re not alone. Welcome to the journey.

LIVE. LOVE. DREAM.

snippet.title: QCSORTER
snippet.description:
Shortly before my retirement six years ago I bought an ebike. I'd cycled all my life but mostly only in the context of commuting to work. The ebike (Cube 625) has opened new worlds for me, especially in terms of access to the Dublin & Wicklow mountains. I've also cycled many times in the Canaries, initially in Fuerteventura and Lanzarote, and latterly in Gran Canaria. 
The reasons for me recording clips of some of my cycles are twofold:
Firstly, I’m not getting any younger and I don't know for how much longer I'll be able to go for long cycles that involve a lot of climbing. I want to have memories to sustain me should I be forced to restrict or give up cycling.
Secondly, I want to encourage other people to take up cycling and to suggest various routes. You won't find videos of me doing hugely technical rides or heading downhill at breakneck speed! They’re made for cyclists like me who enjoy a reasonable challenge, but who are not competitive. 
Happy cycling to all of you!

snippet.title: Kaptain Kechup
snippet.description: Just your average everyday dad who enjoys gaming on weekend evenings with his lovely wife. I found a love for battle Royale games, the journey to the end of the match and the rush when you’re victorious. There’s nothing like it in gaming! Im by no means a pro player, very average skill, but sometimes I have my moments. It’s not about my skill, it’s about overcoming my limitations and using my head to get me and my wife victories. I won’t upload much, as I don’t game on weekdays, just weekends and even then only evenings and nights. As much as I love gaming my kids come first and I have to make sure to balance my hobbies and prioritize what’s more important. I enjoy the hobby of recording my games and uploading the victories and I hope someone may find enjoyment in them. Thanks for visiting my channel.
